basePrompt:
Create a premium but believable PHOTOREALISTIC lifestyle advertising photograph for Pixelkovia, a home family detective adventure with printed A4 clues and one shared smartphone, not a videogame. Portrait 4:5 canvas, target 1080x1350. Warm real Central European home, ordinary lived-in living room, amber practical lamp light mixed with gentle daylight, realistic skin pores and hair flyaways, subtly imperfect clothing, wooden table, natural quiet smiles and concentration rather than stock-photo laughter. Natural 35mm editorial photography, plausible hands with correct anatomy, no synthetic smoothness, no neon, no magic, no toy characters, no fake maps or treasure props.
COMPOSITION: reserve upper 27% as softly defocused dark warm navy room negative space for later editable advertising text. People and activity in middle 32–68%. Foreground table in bottom 32%. At lower left/center show ONE clean BLANK WHITE A4 sheet, only its upper portion visible; lower portion runs beyond bottom edge of canvas. The blank sheet must have clearly visible corners/plane, no text or marks, and no fingers covering its central visible area, so real printed game material can be inserted later. At lower right, on SAME table plane, show ONE realistic dark smartphone with a completely PLAIN UNIFORM near-black screen, all four inner screen corners visible, angled towards camera so screen can be replaced accurately with the actual game screenshot later. Phone should be large enough to read as a real product, approximately 19% canvas width and 24% height; no hands across its screen. Both sheet and phone must be in focus. A hand may point NEXT TO the sheet, not overlap its printable area. No extra blank papers.
The supplied real hand/phone play photos are references for ordinary physical realism and game context, not identity references. Do not reproduce their text or UI: leave screen and sheet blank as explicit compositing placeholders. Do not render ANY advertising text, logos, watermarks, names or buttons. The photograph must fill the entire canvas to all edges, no framing or borders.
